title: patagonium hirsutum
intro: Patagonium hirsutum, commonly known as Queñua, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae, native to the Andes mountain range in South America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and treating respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Queñua are attributed to its ability to soothe and protect the mucous membranes, promoting relaxation and reducing stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine.
